title: Grilled Brazilian Fish Fillet with Light Bowl
description: A delicious and healthy Brazilian-inspired dish featuring a grilled fish fillet served with a light and refreshing bowl of mixed greens.

ingredients.name: Fish fillet
ingredients.notes: Any firm white fish works well, such as tilapia or mahi-mahi

ingredients.name: Cherry tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Halved and added to the light bowl

ingredients.name: Red onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced and added to the light bowl

ingredients.name: Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Chopped and added to the light bowl

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, light olive oil, and Brazilian-style seasoning blend.
Place the fish fillet in a shallow dish and brush the marinade on both sides of the fish.
Season the fish with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the fish for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the light bowl by combining mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and chopped cilantro in a large bowl.
To serve, place the grilled fish fillet on top of the light bowl and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
